dedupe_keys.name: タム諸量テータ 兵庫県 dams reservoirs and flood defences

description: ダム諸量データ_兵庫県 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 兵庫県. 兵庫県が設置しているダムのセンサのリアルタイムデータ（１０分間隔で更新） ・貯水位[m]／貯水量[1000m3]／全流入量[m3/s]／全放流量[m3/s] ・貯水位値は、小数点2桁（0. 01m単位） ・全流入量は、小数点3桁（0. 001m3/s単位） ・全放流量は、小数点3桁（0. 001m3/s単位） 各データ... Coverage: 兵庫県. The portal files it under the publisher 兵庫県. Its tags are センサ, ダム, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
